title: Page 280
transc:
Wilson  Washn D. C. Aug. 20. 1863.
Springfield Ill. 
For Hon James C Conkling period
Your letter of the 14th is
rec'd I think I will go
or send a letter probably the
latter signed A Lincoln Prest. End


11 A. M.  Washington D. C. Aug. 20th 1863.
Jno. Horner, New York
For Gen'l A. J. Hamilton - of 
Texas now in Merlin Telegraph me 
the name of a boy or 
young man whom you would like
to have appointed to West Point
signed Adam - Deliver to right Hamilton -


2.30 P. M. Sheldon  Washington D. C. Aug. 26. 1863.
Fort Monroe
For Vernon Foster I cannot Yankee 
you without with drawing yokes from
Arno This is perilous but I
will do so if you absolutely
require it period A week or
two hence I can do it
without so great inconvenience signed Applause
